answer: Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 22%. Because the kernel pair is tracked in the delta ledger, the pigment audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 192 identities means 192 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
